title: Anmol Kharb Reaches Indonesia Masters Semifinals
indian_angle: Young Indian talent Anmol Kharb continues her impressive run by reaching the semifinals of a significant international tournament.
summary: Anmol Kharb has advanced to the semifinals of the Indonesia Masters 2026, showcasing strong performance on the international stage.

title: Satwik-Chirag Set for China Masters Quarterfinal Clash
indian_angle: India's top men's doubles pair, Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty, are gearing up for a crucial quarterfinal match at the China Masters.
summary: India's star men's doubles duo, Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty, are scheduled to play their China Masters 2026 quarterfinal against Kim Astrup and Anders Skaarup Rasmussen.

title: Srikanth Stuns Lai, Satwik-Chirag Advance at China Masters
indian_angle: Kidambi Srikanth secured a notable upset victory, while Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty also progressed in the China Masters.
summary: Veteran shuttler Kidambi Srikanth delivered a surprise win over Lai at the China Masters, with India's top men's doubles pair Satwik-Chirag also securing a victory.

title: BAI Announces Advanced Coaches Course in Guwahati and Raipur
indian_angle: The Badminton Association of India is organizing an advanced coaching course to enhance the skill level of coaches across the country.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) will conduct a Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course at its National Centers of Excellence in Guwahati and Raipur later this month.

title: Junior National Coaching Camp Held for Asia U17 & U15 Championships
indian_angle: A national coaching camp was held in Guwahati to prepare India's junior shuttlers for the upcoming Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships.
summary: The National Center of Excellence in Guwahati hosted an Indian team coaching camp for players preparing for the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026.

title: BAI Implements 3x15 Scoring System for Junior Domestic Tournaments
indian_angle: The Badminton Association of India has introduced a new 3x15 scoring system for its domestic ranking tournaments and national championships in junior categories.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced the implementation of a 3x15 scoring system for U-13, U-15, and U-17 domestic ranking tournaments and national championships.
